facts.fact: Uganda's ICT state minister Joyce Ssebugwawo officially launched the National Data Strategy on 20 October 2026, described as setting direction for how Uganda manages, protects, shares and uses data; the UBOS director called it illegal.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

facts.fact: ICT minister Justine Kasule Lumumba said on 3 November 2026 that the personal data law and the Personal Data Protection Office under NITA-U give the government its mandate on data; no appointment or ruling is stated.
ICT minister Justine Kasule Lumumba said on 3 November 2026 'we have the law on personal data', with the Personal Data Protection Office under NITA-U giving the mandate on data.
The same statement names the Personal Data Protection Office under NITA-U as holding the data mandate; its appointment is not stated.

UGA.note: Names NITA-U only as holding a data protection mandate; no system run by government staff is stated.
